request: Owner, /portal screenshot of the cabinet «Сейчас» scene: «вот это пространство, оно как-то становится мыльным, и это нужно тоже исправить»; then «удостоверься, что на мобильной версии всё будет не лагать… чтобы анимации запускались сразу».
diagnosis: The ride came from a 1024 px still and a 1080p video, scaled to 2400; the poster was a frame of that video, and the loop ran at 1.75 Mbit/s for 1600 px and 3.65 Mbit/s for 2400 px. When the loop took over from the poster, the whole landscape went soft and blocky. Only 8–17 % of each frame actually moves (Vespi, the dust, some grass); the camera is still (median difference to the poster 2.7/255).
fix: Upscaled the 2400 poster with Higgsfield (bytedance_image_upscale, 4k, job db4466d9-3a72-468c-a338-7ed1d4a0ab16, source imported from the live poster) and brought it back to 2400 × 1810 (Lanczos); it lines up with the video (low-pass difference 1.17/255).

For each frame, motion is measured against the old soft poster (so the upscale's extra detail is not taken for motion): mean absolute difference at quarter size, blur 1, threshold 13, held over ±3 frames around the loop, dilated (max 9) and feathered (blur 5). Mean coverage 16.7 %. Where it is 0 the frame is the sharp still; where it is 1 the frame is the video; in between a soft blend.

Encoded from one composite pass: x264 slow, CRF 21 / 22 / 25 at 2400 / 1600 / 960, one keyframe at the restart (keyint 400, scenecut 0), BT.709 tags, faststart; VP9 960 CRF 36, g 400. Same 252 frames and timing, so startAt stays 105.5/30.
Posters landscapes/tuscany-{960,1600,2400}.webp are composite frame 105 (where the loop starts), WebP q82, so the handover from the picture to the loop is invisible and both are sharp.
